title: Financial Inclusion & Micro-lending Analytics
thesis: Snowflake builds alternative credit scores using remittance patterns, e-wallet behavior, and telco data via ML.CLASSIFICATION, enabling micro-lending decisions for the unbanked — replacing expensive SageMaker pipelines with native SQL ML

talking_points: ₱8.2 billion total portfolio with 3.8% default rate (below 5% target).
Alternative data model approves 42% more applicants vs traditional bureau scoring.
tabs.call_out: 65% unbanked borrowers served — 42% more approvals vs traditional scoring

transition.line: Let's see how alternative data enables these lending decisions.

talking_points: ML.CLASSIFICATION trained on 145K historical loans — Gini coefficient 0.62.
Top predictive features: remittance frequency (22%), wallet savings ratio (18%), telco payment consistency (15%).
TOP_INSIGHTS reveals: receiving remittances >3x/month is strongest positive signal.
tabs.call_out: Remittance frequency is the #1 credit signal — better than income proof

transition.line: The model works. Let's check the portfolio is staying healthy.

talking_points: Default rate: 3.8% overall, but varying by region — Mindanao at 4.9% (approaching threshold).
Vintage analysis: Q2 2024 cohort performing best at 2.1% default after 6 months.
Model monitoring: PSI at 0.12 — stable, no drift detected.
show: Show default rate by region map
tabs.call_out: Portfolio healthy at 3.8% default — Mindanao approaching 5% threshold

transition.line: Let the CLO ask the system directly.

talking_points: Rosario asks: 'How many unbanked borrowers did we serve in Visayas this quarter?'
Cortex Analyst: 24,300 new unbanked borrowers in Visayas — 18% QoQ growth.
Follow-up: 'What does BSP say about alt-credit scoring regulations?' — searches BSP circulars.

talking_points: Three alternative data sources → Dynamic Tables → ML.CLASSIFICATION → scoring in minutes.
ML.CLASSIFICATION replaces SageMaker — no endpoints to manage, no Docker containers.
46% of Filipino adults unbanked (BSP 2023). This platform has already served 380K.
tabs.call_out: Financial inclusion at scale — native ML, no ML ops

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Philippine financial inclusion.
